description.value: Deville Coffee Bernard is a specialty coffee chain cafe situated on Bernard Avenue, Kelowna's main downtown thoroughfare and a natural waypoint for cyclists exploring the city core. The chain operates across Western Canada with a focus on quality coffee and a streamlined cafe experience. An order-ahead option makes it a quick stop for riders who want to minimize time off the bike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is the Bernard Ave location of Deville Coffee at 387 Bernard Ave, Kelowna BC V1Y 6N6, with phone 250 801-9867 — both differ from OSM (no address; phone +1 778 940 6018). The OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'ORDER AHEAD' feature. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1 778 940 6018; website lists 250 801-9867 for the Bernard Ave location. OSM number may belong to the Lakeshore location or be outdated.
OSM has no street address; address 387 Bernard Ave, Kelowna BC V1Y 6N6 sourced from website only.
No bike parking, washroom, or other required cyclist amenities confirmed from website or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, active cafe on Kelowna's main downtown street and is useful to touring cyclists, but no bike parking or visibility evidence could be confirmed — the sole required criterion for a Food & Drink listing. On-site verification or direct outreach is needed before listing.
